sections.title: Sounds of eigh
paragraphs: The letters eigh make the main sound in (weigh) /weɪ/, which means to measure heaviness. This letter group makes two sounds in English. You hear this spelling in common words. One vowel sound is much more common than the other.

sections.title: How to say eigh
paragraphs: For the main sound, start with your tongue in the middle. Spread your lips slightly and glide your tongue upward. A diphthong is two vowel sounds in one syllable, where the sound glides from the first to the second. For the second sound, open your mouth wide. Lower your tongue, then glide it smoothly toward the top front of your mouth. Touch your throat to feel that both sounds are voiced.

sections.title: Spelling patterns of eigh
paragraphs: The letters eigh usually make the sound you hear in (sleigh) /sleɪ/. This is the most common pronunciation for this group. In a few special words, the same letters make the sound you hear in (height) /haɪt/. The letters g and h stay silent in both cases.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pronounce the letters g or h in this group. They are completely silent. Also avoid making a single flat vowel. Remember to glide smoothly between the two vowel parts.
